message: `s` carries an effect, so it must be named `ctx`
fix: rename `s` to `ctx` and make it the first parameter, or take a type that implements no effect if this parameter is ordinary data
notes: `Ticker` implements the effect `Clock`, so holding one is holding the capability
a function is effectful if and only if it has a `ctx` parameter or an effect-carrying `self`, which is what lets a reader stop after the first two parameters
